integrity_notes: Proof includes a positive-definite quartic return argument for the identity-multiplier endpoint, analytic two-sided inverse-square comparison, scalar sharpness calculation, and reproducible finite diagnostics. The calculations are not substitutes for the analytic claims.
scientific_limitations: Connected positively weighted biregular bipartite graphs, sinusoidal reciprocal map, one symmetric no-winding two-color branch; asymptotics are local on the common-phase quotient. Other periodic orbits and the nonlinear asymptotic direction distribution are not classified.
title: Algebraically attracting parabolic two-cycles on weighted bipartite phase networks
